import zipfile, pathlib, subprocess, os
z=zipfile.ZipFile('fuzz/fuzz_type_object/fuzz_type_object_seed_corpus.zip')
for name in z.namelist()[:3]:
    p=pathlib.Path('/workspace/corpus')/name
    p.write_bytes(z.read(name))
    trace='[]'
    pathlib.Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(trace)
    print('trying',name)
    r=subprocess.run(['/workspace/submit.sh',str(p),'/workspace/candidate_trace.json'],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True)
    print(r.stdout.splitlines()[-5:])
